SMTO-SKL-0191 — This GitHub file must be downloaded, not shown in chat

GUID: ef51dc42-389e-59ac-9a7c-561c793bf5f0
Slug: github-content-requires-artifact
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: github

What happened

  • The file you asked for is too large or isn't plain text (for example an image or program file), so SMTO can't show it in the chat. It can be downloaded as a file instead.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the Agent to download this GitHub file as a file instead of showing its contents. Large or non-text files can only come through as downloads.
  2. If you only need part of a large text file, tell the Agent which part you want, such as a section name or a range of lines, once the file is downloaded. The Agent can look through the downloaded copy without the chat's size limit.

What success looks like

  • The file appears in the Conversation as a download.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with the file's path on GitHub.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • github.contents refused to return a file inline because it is over 64 KiB, is not base64-encoded by GitHub, or does not decode as valid UTF-8 text (for example a binary file).

What this means

  • Inline repository content exceeds 64 KiB, lacks base64 encoding or cannot decode as valid UTF-8 text. This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.

Why this can happen

  • Inline repository content exceeds 64 KiB, lacks base64 encoding or cannot decode as valid UTF-8 text.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect declared size, encoding and decoding outcome for the exact path/ref.

How to fix it

  • Call github.contents with as_artifact=true to stream the file into a conversation artifact (up to 100 MiB). Inline contents are limited to UTF-8 text of at most 64 KiB before projection.
  • Call github.contents with as_artifact=true for binary or large files. Inline text must be UTF-8 and at most 64 KiB before projection.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The supported as_artifact route retrieves the intended content without forcing binary bytes into text.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
